features.feature: Construct an updatable evidence-gap state from CTI/local-evidence alignment
features.technical_effect: provides a machine-operable state for subsequent evidence acquisition

features.feature: Separate public action-intent nodes from hidden realized recoverable evidence
features.technical_effect: prevents the planner from reading the environment answer key

features.feature: Select an action by evidence-gap compatibility and cost under a remaining budget
features.technical_effect: converts current evidence gaps into an executable acquisition decision
features.destination: independent claim; formula details in dependent claim/embodiment

features.feature: Apply acquisition-channel outcome and execution feedback before updating evidence state
features.technical_effect: represents unreliable telemetry and reliable fallback without pre-exposing outcomes

features.feature: Output a support-limited granularity or explicit STOP/degrade result
features.technical_effect: prevents unsupported granularity escalation and terminates futile acquisition

features.feature: Use an LLM to compile heterogeneous inputs into schema-constrained evidence claims
features.destination: inventor question or future experiment; exclude from formal independent claim

features.feature: Online LLM/GNN/RL utility prediction provides superior action planning
features.destination: exclude; C11 and C12 show case-dependent ranking rather than stable learned-policy superiority

features.feature: M3a reduces acquisition cost relative to M2
features.technical_effect: contradicted by C07-C10; C11 and C12 further show that policy ordering changes with source and support ceiling
features.destination: explicitly exclude from paper and patent effect statements

features.feature: Use finite-depth search or dynamic programming when actions have prerequisite or unlock relations
features.technical_effect: avoids systematic selection of high-immediate-yield distractors in the controlled prerequisite environment
features.destination: dependent claim and embodiment; real C11/C12 evidence is case-specific and does not establish DQN necessity

features.feature: Validate source metadata and event pointers, and separate raw event observations from vendor-derived context projections before compiling evidence claims
features.technical_effect: preserves traceability and prevents correlation projections or automated labels from being treated as independent event truth
features.destination: optional embodiment and possible dependent-claim candidate pending prior-art search and patent-agent review
